mapper.sql: select document_version_id, document_id, version_no, storage_type, bucket_name, object_key, original_file_name, file_extension, content_type, file_size, file_hash, parsed_object_key, page_count, process_status, process_message, index_status, index_message, index_content_hash, indexed_chunk_count, embedding_model, embedding_dimension, milvus_collection, indexed_time, del_flag, create_by, create_time from oc_document_version
mapper.select: select d.knowledge_base_id from oc_document_version v inner join oc_document d on d.document_id = v.document_id where v.document_version_id = #{documentVersionId} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into oc_document_version ( document_id, version_no, storage_type, bucket_name, object_key, original_file_name, file_extension, content_type, file_size, file_hash, parsed_object_key, page_count, process_status, process_message, del_flag, create_by, create_time ) values ( #{documentId}, #{versionNo}, #{storageType}, #{bucketName}, #{objectKey}, #{originalFileName}, #{fileExtension}, #{contentType}, #{fileSize}, #{fileHash}, #{parsedObjectKey}, #{pageCount}, #{processStatus}, #{processMessage}, '0', #{createBy}, sysdate() )
mapper.update: update oc_document_version set parsed_object_key = #{parsedObjectKey}, page_count = #{pageCount}, process_status = '2', process_message = #{processMessage} where document_version_id = #{documentVersionId} and del_flag = '0'

update oc_document_version set index_status = '2', index_message = #{indexMessage}, index_content_hash = #{indexContentHash}, indexed_chunk_count = #{indexedChunkCount}, embedding_model = #{embeddingModel}, embedding_dimension = #{embeddingDimension}, milvus_collection = #{milvusCollection}, indexed_time = sysdate() where document_version_id = #{documentVersionId} and del_flag = '0' and process_status = '2'

update oc_document_version set index_status = '0', index_message = #{indexMessage}, index_content_hash = null, indexed_chunk_count = null, embedding_model = null, embedding_dimension = null, milvus_collection = null, indexed_time = null where document_version_id = #{documentVersionId} and del_flag = '0' and process_status = '2'
